title: Child in a stage play
summary: A short memory of appearing as a child in a legitimate theatre play.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Of course, I'd been on the stage before that. I was in a stage play with... Save the life of me, I can't figure out what the heck the play was. It was at one of the theatres downtown. And a bunch of us kids, like, naturally shootin' crap...heh-heh. What else, huh!? Then the lady come in who
was supposed to be our mother, and we all ran to her, you know.
